sentence: This project uses an underwater robot to observe how fast tidewater glaciers melt and what controls it.
This project builds a platform that gives open access to tools for developing materials that can operate in extreme environments.
This project studies how genome doubling changes the way goatsbeard plants respond to heat and drought.
This project builds courses and digital learning tools that teach the electronic systems used in modern aircraft.
This project builds a tool that uses labeling and imaging of single cells to study how cells respond to physical stimulation.
This project studies how peatland fires and road construction affect the health and energy balance of wild orangutans.
This project studies how a group of proteins protects the ends of chromosomes in a well-studied worm.
This project lets neurons team up with machine intelligence models to create images containing the visual information neurons encode.
This project builds efficient computer methods for predicting how radiation, light, or particles move through complex media.
This project improves a statistical technique that measures prediction uncertainty so it works with noisy and incomplete data.
This project studies whether the diet of non-human primates is linked to how their teeth respond to selective pressures.
This project builds software tools that correct distortion in three-dimensional images of the molecules within a sample.
This project tests present theories of particle physics with experimental data and searches for evidence of dark sectors.
This project builds compact, ultrafast sensors and signal converters that combine atomically thin materials with specially designed electromagnetic structures.
This project uses computer simulations to study how small structures in a collisionless plasma stay stable or change over time.
This project develops computer algorithms that help vehicles move safely through intersections and avoid collisions.
This project develops ways to simulate quantum integrable models on quantum computers and to prepare exact many-body quantum states.
This project builds a brain-inspired transistor that combines long-term and short-term memory in a single device.
